Messages.Author: Metropolis
Messages.Body:
I believe this question is trivial,

Minion A & B have eternal vigilance on them, Minion C announces an action,
can Minion A & B both burn 1 blood to untap and attempt to block, or do they
have to do it one a time? (this situation of course assumes they are
eligable blockers)

Since only one minion can attempt to block an action at a time, I believe
that answer is no they cannot attempt this course of action.

Metropolis

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


One at a time is correct. The second can try only if the first doesn't
succeed.
